defect.evidence_quote: So long as a later, lawful seizure is genuinely independent of an earlier, tainted one (which may well be difficult to establish where the seized goods are kept in the police’s possession) there is no reason why the independent source doctrine should not apply.
defect.problem: The holding field is cut off with an ellipsis and omits the full limiting condition: the later acquisition must be lawful and genuinely independent of the earlier entry, with remand required because the lower-court findings did not establish independence.
defect.proposed_fix: Independent source: evidence first observed during an unlawful entry may be admitted if later obtained through a lawful, warrant-authorized search genuinely independent of the earlier entry; remand was required where the factfinder had not found independence.
